t: Din mi sheen lo mayim vehammaakil laacherim
s: Din mi sheen lo mayim vehammaakil laacherim, ubo b' seipim: asur leekol belo netila, apillu im rotzeh likrok yadayv bemappa o okel bekap sheeno nogea bappat, gezera shemma yigga. Vaapillu hamhallek badderek vehiggia et haokel velo matza mayim, im yodea sheyyesh lepanayv mayim berichuq d' milin — tzarik lehamtin ad sheyyaggia lesham. Veim yesh mayim leacharayv bepachot mimmil — tzarik lachazor lesham ap al pi shennachutz ledarko. Abal im yesh berichuq mil leacharayv veyoter mid' milin lepanayv — yikrok yadayv bemappa veyokal pitto o dabar shettibbulo bemashqeh, o okel al yede kap. Veken im hu sapeq im yimtza mayim betok d' milin. Veshomer ginna o pardes — dino kilacharayv, lepi shei epshar lo laazob shemirato kol kak ad sheyyelek mil veyachazor. Abal hayyosheb bebeto tzarik lelek d' milin im yodea sheyyimtza mayim:

Hammaakil laacherim — en tzarik netilat yadayim. Vehaokel — tzarik netilat yadayim, ap al pi shehammaakil noten happat letok piv vehu eno nogea bappat, gezera shemma yigga. Vehammaakil, ap shennogea — lo gazeru alayv, lepi shello gazeru al negiat chullin, ella al akila mishshum serek teruma, ubemaakal shehu dabar sheeno matzuy — lo gazeru. Veasur lehaakil lemi sheyyodea bo shello natal yadayv, mishshum "velipne ivver lo titten mikshol". Vaapillu happat shel haokel, raq shemmoshito lo — asur lesayyea yede obere abera, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman shm"z:
